display.purpose: Document, repository and home titles. 36/48/60px at base/sm/xl, bold, tracking -0.035em.

headline.purpose: Markdown h2 under a hairline top rule.

title.purpose: Markdown h3, repo-row names, pager targets.

label.purpose: Navigation, metadata, breadcrumbs, chips. Active state is bold, not larger.

code.purpose: Code, inline code and source paths only.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: No shadow at rest, hover or in Mermaid (dropShadow: none). Overlays use a border instead.

shadows.name: selected-underline
shadows.purpose: Selected-state underline on the theme toggle option; not a depth device.

motion.name: chevron-rotate
motion.value: transform, Tailwind default transition, rotate 90deg when open

motion.name: color-shift
motion.purpose: Hover moves links to Ink or Signal Blue; nothing animates on load or scroll.

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; min-height: 64px; padding: 0 32px; background: var(--background, #ffffff); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e4); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--foreground, #111111); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--muted-foreground, #5c5c5c); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--foreground, #111111); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #2b59ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Submit Button

narrative.overview:
DocMyRepos is a reference manual set in the International Typographic Style. Hierarchy does all the work: weight, scale and rules replace boxes, tinted fills and shadows, so nothing performs behind the text. It is built for newcomers and cross-team readers who must find the right document and always know where they stand. The familiar documentation arrangement is kept on purpose (header search, contents tree on the left, article in the middle, on-this-page outline on the right) and expressed in the Swiss grid.

One grotesque carries every word. Ink on white (near-black on near-black in dark) carries every surface. One blue appears only where it means something: the current location, links, focus and the primary hover. Everything is flush left. The system refuses the card-grid-with-soft-borders docs portal, and the build backs that up: repositories and results are ruled rows, not tiles.

Light and dark are both first-class. Dark is a near-black surface with lighter accents rather than an inversion, and every pairing is gated by contrast tests.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface (Hanken Grotesk, 400 and 700) with tight negative tracking on large titles; monospace only for code and paths.
Ink, paper and one blue. Grey carries secondary text and nothing else.
Hairline rules and bold ink rules draw structure; no shadows at rest.
Near-square corners (2px on code and keys).
Document-first reading column near 60rem, with navigation as flanking columns.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue means "you are here, or you can act here." It is never decoration, never a fill behind body copy, and never a second accent.

rules.name: The Contrast Gate Rule
rules.body: Raw colors live only in the :root and .dark blocks of globals.css, mirrored in src/lib/theme-tokens.ts. Every pairing used is listed in CONTRAST_PAIRS and fails the unit test below 4.5:1 (text) or 3:1 (UI). A new color enters both files and the pair list, or it does not ship.

rules.name: The One Grotesque Rule
rules.body: One family, two weights in the system's own chrome (400 and 700). Hierarchy is made with size, weight, tracking and rules, never a second face.

rules.name: The Mono Is Code Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only for code, inline code, source paths and result paths. Keyboard hints such as the palette shortcut use the sans.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: A surface is never lifted by shadow. If something must read as above, it is an overlay and it earns a border, not a blur.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Box Rule
rules.body: Group content with a rule above or below it. Do not wrap it in a bordered, filled or shadowed container.

dos: Do mark the current location with Signal Blue plus bold (tree) or the 1px blue bar (outline), and use blue for nothing else decorative.
Do separate content with a 1px rule: Ink above panels and lists, Hairline below rows.
Do build hierarchy from size, weight (400 or 700) and tracking (-0.035em on display titles).
Do keep the document column near 60rem and put the article before the navigation in the DOM.
Do add any new color to both token blocks and to CONTRAST_PAIRS, and check light and dark.
Do keep monospace for code and paths only.
donts: Don't wrap repositories, results or panels in bordered, tinted or shadowed cards.
Don't add shadows outside overlays; depth comes from position and rules.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or use blue as a fill behind body text.
Don't round surfaces beyond 4px; only chips and badges are pill-shaped.
Don't add a second typeface or a display face for headings.
Don't color-only signal a link inside running text; text links are underlined.
